posts.text: Found some interesting data in a research paper that can help assess 3B’s market acceptance and share in infectious disease testing, specifically dengue PCR. Published on 3 Sep 2026, this paper assessed dengue testing quality in India’s Virus Research and Diagnostic Laboratory network from Dec 2024 to Feb 2026. Combining brand and company entries in the chart puts 3B BlackBio first with 17 entries, or 25% share. TRUPCR was used in 11 labs and 3B BlackBio in another 6 (not sure why they are separated).
